Title: Retirement: Azure Stream Analytics PowerBI output connector

Body.Content:
Azure stream analytics PowerBI output connector will be retired on Oct 31, 2027.

What is changing for Azure Stream Analytics Power BI output connector?

DateWhat happens
Beginning October 31st, 2024
New customers will not be able to create new Azure Stream Analytics jobs with Power BI as output connector
Beginning Oct 31 31st, 2027
Existing customers will not be able to create new Azure Stream Analytics jobs with Power BI as output connector
Beginning Oct 31 31st, 2027
Existing Azure Stream Analytic jobs with Power BI output connector will be stopped

Reason for retirement: Power BI has announced retirement of real time streaming. Find out more details about Power BI Streaming Datasets retirement: real time streaming in Power BI.

We encourage you to transition to Fabric real time intelligence prior to the retirement date to experience the new capabilities of Fabric Real Time Intelligence including:

  •       Eventstream 
  •       KQL Database 
  •       DataActivator 
  •       Real Time Dashboards

From now to 10/31/2027 existing customers can continue to use Azure stream analytics PowerBI output connector without disruption. On 10/31/2027 stream analytics jobs running with PowerBI output connector will be stopped. Resources to aid in your migration can be found below.

Required action

To avoid service disruptions, please follow these instructions to migrate to real time intelligence by 10/31/2027.

Learn more.
